purpose: E2 medium-head experiment: test reduced joint-schema capacity with a conservative shared AdamW recipe on v2 cached frozen Qwen3.5-9B features. Relative to E2, change head architecture, LR 1e-3 to 3e-4 and decay only matrix parameters (not scalar/vector parameters). Preserve splits, seed, microbatch four, effective batch 64, five full epochs without early stopping, dev-NLL checkpoint selection and separate temperature calibration. Medium versus Small uses the same optimizer recipe; E2 comparison changes both architecture and optimization. One-seed exploratory comparison.
